name: remove-ai-watermarks
description: Removes and identifies AI watermarks and provenance marks in images, video, audio, and text the user generated or edited. Covers Gemini sparkles, SynthID, Microsoft InvisMark, Meta Content Seal, C2PA, EXIF/XMP/IPTC metadata, compatible public AudioSeal/WavMark/Perth v1/SilentCipher audio, and Sora/Veo/Seedance/Doubao/Dola/Hailuo/Vidu/Kling and Wan labels. Use when the user wants to strip or clean AI watermarks and generation labels, or asks whether a file was AI-generated or carries AI provenanc
author: wiltodelta
